name: B10-0391/2025 (PfE) – Case of Victoire Ingabire in Rwanda
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Victoire Ingabire in Rwanda
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for the release of Rwandan opposition leader Victoire Ingabire, arrested in June 2025 on charges it sees as politically motivated. It asks Rwanda to free her, restore her political rights and respect independent courts. It also urges the European Union and its member states to put diplomatic pressure on Rwanda, possibly through visa bans or money sanctions, and to review EU support for the Rwandan government. The text is a statement of position; it does not itself change any law.

- Nothing changes yet: Parliament only states demands and asks EU states and the Commission to act.
- It concerns Victoire Ingabire, Rwanda's government, and EU support to Rwanda.
- Next, the text goes to EU leaders, the Commission, the African Union, the UN and Rwanda.
